desired_outcome: Produce an implementation-ready, repository-grounded plan that fixes the Claude v3 failures: late environment discovery, stale Workbench state, weak evidence provenance, duplicated completion hooks, schema-heavy ceremony, and excessive investigation cost.

facts.statement: Claude v3 invoked Workbench and diagnosing-bugs, but it routed and advanced the proposal before asking whether the observed slowdown was local or deployed; the user's deployed answer materially changed the option ranking.

The revised deployed recommendation initially treated authorization-request duration as endpoint latency and ranked provisioned concurrency first; the diagnosis completion guard forced later retractions and a narrower final conclusion.
The environment correction was written to an unregistered addendum because Workbench v0.5 has no supported post-start route-correction mutation, leaving durable lifecycle state stale.
The transcript records four avoidable Workbench schema-validation failures while hand-building routing and handoff records.
Claude currently receives the portable claude-rigor Stop hook and a separate legacy global completion_guard.py Stop hook; the global settings also register the Workbench diagnosis PreToolUse hook.

Existing adherence evaluations cover method composition, post-start correction blocking, quantitative provenance, aggregate metrics, and fixture-bounded claims, but not environment-before-ranking, active-source provenance, or proposal gating on material uncertainty.

rationale: The failures cross the installed Claude harness, Workbench lifecycle behavior, distribution configuration, and regression evaluations. The user requested a plan rather than implementation, so the route should resolve interfaces, sequencing, acceptance criteria, and rollout without modifying those systems yet.

assumptions: Workbench remains append-only and Claude-specific enforcement stays outside its portable policy core.
recommendation.choice: Add preventive preflight and proposal gates first, then a bounded correction path and one-hook migration.
recommendation.rationale: Most v3 waste and stale state began before proposal acceptance. Preventing that error is smaller and higher leverage; append-only correction remains necessary as a safety net, while hook consolidation removes contradictory duplicate reviews.
tradeoffs: A stricter preflight may add one early question when environment cannot be discovered.
Post-start correction adds runtime and replay complexity, so it should follow the preventive controls.
